note: HP and ATK equal the current values for every card. Character effect rows listed under proposed.effects were validated with parseEffect. Spells/traps/EVO/FUS have no data change; engine work is listed in engine_proposals.

engine_proposals.title: SPL-007: stolen unit cannot attack the turn it arrives
engine_proposals.status: PROPOSED / NOT APPROVED / NEW ENGINE WORK
engine_proposals.change: In the SPL-007 case of src/engine/game.ts set summonedTurn = g.turn on both swapped units (the existing "just summoned cannot attack" rule then applies).
engine_proposals.evidence: verify.spl007: stolenCanAttackSameTurn = true (a Lv70 FOLLOW-YOU-070 obtained for a Lv15 attacks at once).

engine_proposals.title: SPL-003 / SPL-004: cap stacking per unit
engine_proposals.status: PROPOSED / NOT APPROVED / NEW ENGINE WORK
engine_proposals.change: Allow one SPL-003 and one SPL-004 buff per unit, or cap total bonusDef / bonusAtk from spells at +30 (Toon decides the form). Needs a per-unit counter in Unit.
engine_proposals.evidence: verify.spl003x3: bonusDef 45; verify.spl004x3: bonusAtk 45 (total ATK 75 from a 30-ATK unit).

engine_proposals.title: Optional: spells per turn limit (e.g. 2)
engine_proposals.status: PROPOSED / NOT APPROVED / NEW ENGINE WORK / OPTIONAL
engine_proposals.change: Add a per-turn spell counter on Player; reject the 3rd cast.
engine_proposals.evidence: verify.spellVolume: 3 casts in one turn, deck 30 -> 21 (SPL-005 draws).

engine_proposals.title: Optional: activate the "combo" trigger (FOLLOW-YOU-040)
engine_proposals.status: PROPOSED / NOT APPROVED / NEW ENGINE WORK / OPTIONAL
engine_proposals.change: Define "another Combo card on the field" in the parser/registry and the engine; today any combo row returns null from parseEffect and is not executed. Must stay in parity with src/engine/effect-registry.ts.
engine_proposals.evidence: effects.ts parseRaw does not accept trigger "combo"; has_combo exists only as card metadata.

engine_proposals.title: Text/data alignment: SPL-003 and SPL-004 duration
engine_proposals.change: Choose one canonical behaviour: "until the unit leaves the field" (what the engine does and rules_text says) or "until end of turn" (what the effect row says). Update the other text; if the engine is changed it is new engine work.
engine_proposals.evidence: Effect row: DEF +15 จนจบเทิร์น; rules_text and engine: until the unit leaves the field.
